_note: 2026-11-13 (plan L0-CLOSE step 8): the pass has its own reference error, pass_error_ref_rad (a pass is aimed at a man who comes to meet it), today equal to the shot's. The kick (ADR-051, the family 'the kick'), first for the shot. No die (ADR-035). Speed: speed_ref x (base + (1 - base) x power) x (explosive_base + (1 - explosive_base) x explosive_force), cm/tick (10 ticks = 1 s): a placed shot by an average player leaves at about 17 m/s, a strong one at about 23 m/s, the strongest at about 28 m/s. Precision is an angle: error = error_ref x (1 - skill) x (0.5 + power_gain x power) + error_pressure x pressure, in radians, with skill = shooting x (0.5 + 0.5 x the quality of the foot he kicks with); the miss is the distance times the angle, so the same player misses by more from farther away, and a strong shot is less precise than a placed one. vertical_share is the share of the error that goes up (a miscued strike rises). aim_low_cm and aim_high_cm are the heights the shooter aims at for a low and a high shot (his contact_height choice). The pass is weighed (2026-11-13): the passer gives it the speed that brings it to the receiver still rolling at pass_arrive_cm_per_tick (6 m/s), knowing the ground friction (ball.json): v0 = arrive + distance x (1 - friction), capped by his strongest kick; the error angle (from passing and the foot) makes it drift across the line by distance x angle and overhit by the same share. A clearance (2026-11-13): his strongest kick, towards a point clear_length_cm up the pitch on the wing of his side, lifted (the vertical speed is clear_loft of the horizontal one). A lofted pass (2026-11-13) flies loft_ticks_per_10m ticks for every ten metres (0.6 s: a 30 m ball is in the air about 1.8 s) and is lifted to stay up that long; its error widens the distance as for a ground pass.
_source: Order of magnitude from observation of real matches: shot speeds of about 15-30 m/s; about one shot in three on target. Arbitrary, declared, to be calibrated at L3 against real shot speed, placement and on-target distributions.
